2609.24651.title: Corrective Forcing: Unified Post-Training for Diffusions and Flows in Generative Speech Enhancement
2609.24651.paper_summary: Diffusion and flow models, as promising generative paradigms for speech enhancement, face a training--inference mismatch: training uses analytical path states, whereas inference recursively evaluates models on self-generated rollout states along discretized sampling trajectories. This mismatch causes prediction and discretization errors to accumulate. To address it, we introduce Corrective Forcing (CoF), a post-training paradigm that forces diffusion and flow models to learn from self-generated rollouts and correct their predictions. CoF corrects clean-speech predictions on rollout states toward the ground truth under dynamic sampling schedules, exposing the model to varying inference conditions. It further regularizes local evolution using locally corrected counterfactual transitions as references for factual transitions. By expressing model outputs through a shared clean-speech prediction parameterization, CoF applies the same post-training objective across diffusion and flow formulations. Experiments with SB-VE and OT-CFM demonstrate improvements in perceptual quality and reconstruction fidelity, together with robust performance across different numbers of sampling steps.
2609.24651.paper_summary_zh: 擴散和流模型作為語音增強的有前景生成範式，面臨著訓練與推理的不匹配：訓練使用分析路徑狀態，而推理則在自生成的展開狀態上沿著離散化的取樣軌跡遞歸評估模型。這種不匹配導致預測和離散化錯誤的累積。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了修正強制（CoF），這是一種後訓練範式，強迫擴散和流模型從自生成的展開中學習並修正其預測。CoF在動態取樣計劃下修正展開狀態的清晰語音預測，使模型暴露於不同的推理條件中。它進一步使用局部修正的反事實轉換作為事實轉換的參考，來正則化局部演變。通過通過共享的清晰語音預測參數化來表達模型輸出，CoF在擴散和流的公式中應用相同的後訓練目標。與SB-VE和OT-CFM的實驗表明，在感知質量和重建保真度方面有所改善，並在不同取樣步數下表現出穩健的性能。
